title: Mint Momentum
tagline: Inspire, Motivate, and Earn on chain where motivation meets blockchain technology
description: Mint Momentum is a on-chain platform where motivation meets blockchain technology. Share your most inspiring tips, quotes, and life hacks, and watch as your wisdom resonates across the community. When your motivational content strikes a chord, others can instantly reward you with cryptocurrency tips, creating a positive feedback loop of inspiration and appreciation.
how_its_made: I developed the decentralized application (dApp) using React for the frontend and styled it with Chakra UI to create a beautiful user interface. For the smart contract development, I utilized Hardhat, a powerful toolchain for Ethereum development, to write and deploy smart contract.
